latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Migrated the skill to a different accounting API provider and updated endpoints accordingly.

- Switched API provider from unify.apideck.com (API v10.24.7) to api.codat.io (API v3.0.0)
- Refreshed authentication, setup steps, and base URL information
- Updated endpoint list from 143 endpoints to 135 endpoints, focusing on company-based operations
- Revised descriptions to reflect new API coverage and adjusted naming for accuracy
- Documentation now reflects endpoints, paths, and resource structure for the new provider
